Release: datasette-charts 0.2a0

I introduced this new charting plugin for Datasette yesterday. Today it's gained integration with Datasette Agent, so now you can ask chat for a chart and it will create one for you using the same underlying chart suggestion and generation tools.

Here's a demo video, recorded on agent.datasette.io where you can sign in with GitHub to try the plugin yourself:

Here's a Markdown export of the chat from the video.

Tags: datasette-agent, datasette, visualization
content_text: Release: datasette-charts 0.2a0 I introduced this new charting plugin for Datasette yesterday . Today it's gained integration with Datasette Agent , so now you can ask chat for a chart and it will create one for you using the same underlying chart suggestion and generation tools. Here's a demo video, recorded on agent.datasette.io where you can sign in with GitHub to try the plugin yourself: Download the video (MP4) I prompt Datasette Agent to "Use #stats to show sqlite-utils downloads over time as a chart" - where typing "#stats" opens a table search box. It shows me a chart inline in the chat, and when I click "Open in the chart builder" it opens the chart in a panel along with the table page. I use the table page to switch to a chart of "datasette", then when I ask the agent "what does the chart show?" it notices that I changed the content in the panel and describes the new Datasette chart to me. Here's a Markdown export of the chat from the video. Tags: datasette-agent , datasette , visualization
